notes: Checked Kalaupapa/Kalawao official and quasi-official sources. Kalawao has no normal county government and is administered through Hawaii DOH/Kalaupapa; searches for data center/server farm/colocation found no project-level development, only unrelated health-data and generic vendor pages.

status_detail: County of Kauai 2022 USDOT RAISE application materials state that the Knudsen Trust plans to build a data center in Koloa to support mobility-data systems and transportation technology; no later construction/operation confirmation found in quick county/news search.
notes: Included under broad scope because the county's own grant narrative identifies a private data center plan. Capacity and final status not disclosed; may be transportation/mobility data infrastructure rather than hyperscale colocation.

aliases: Maui High Performance Computing Center DSRC
Vanguard Center of DoD High Performance Computing
developer: U.S. Department of Defense / Air Force Research Laboratory; managed by University of Hawaii under contract
status_detail: Official county and federal sources identify MHPCC in the Maui Research and Technology Park in Kihei as an operating DoD high-performance computing/supercomputing resource center with high-bandwidth connectivity.
notes: Not a commercial hyperscale data center, but it is an operational high-performance computing/data-center facility in Maui County. Capacity in MW not disclosed in official sources reviewed.

aliases: Applied Digital Adair County Data Center
status_detail: Adair County Board of Supervisors minutes from April 2, 2024 record Applied Digital representatives presenting a potential Adair site for a 200 MW data center, with one 300,000 sf building first and a second later; April 24, 2024 minutes discussed a data-center ordinance and noted the ordinance would not stop the project. March 18, 2026 minutes later imposed a temporary moratorium on data centers/high-density computing/battery storage in unincorporated Adair County.
notes: Official minutes provide the strongest evidence for the proposal and capacity. DCD/local news add that the site was reported near the 1200 block of Fallow Avenue adjacent to a NextEra substation. No construction confirmation found in this quick pass.

Checked county official documents, economic-development site, and local news. Allamakee adopted Amendment 20 to Zoning Ordinance L for data centers in April 2026 after public comment, and earlier P&Z agendas discussed a data center/cryptocurrency ordinance, but no named project, developer, site, application, or permit was found.

Checked Appanoose County official site/board materials search results and PACT economic-development/chamber resources. Data-center search hits were internal IT/GIS contract language or unrelated regional/state material; no project-level data center development found.

Checked Audubon County economic-development and Board of Supervisors records. The county approved Resolution 2026-27 authorizing a temporary moratorium on commercial data centers and held/publicized related hearings, but no specific data center proposal, developer, site, or permit was found.

Checked Benton County official site, Benton Development Group, and targeted searches for data center/server farm/colocation. Results pointed to neighboring Linn/Cedar Rapids data center activity and unrelated State Data Center references, not a Benton County project.

aliases: Wahawk Power LLC Waterloo data center
status_detail: Waterloo City Council minutes show approval on December 15, 2025 of sale/conveyance of about 12 acres north of 570 West Shaulis Road to Wahawk Power, LLC for $1 and approval of a development/minimum assessment agreement for a new 80,000 sf data center with accessory water treatment area and substation, minimum assessed value of $6 million, and 10-year 50% tax rebate.
notes: Official city records are the primary evidence; private brokerage writeup summarizes the same deal and says it is in South Waterloo Business Park. MW capacity not disclosed; city minutes record a typical water-use range of 43,000 to 230,000 gallons/day depending on cooling system.
